definition: An Interrupt's result: the target card's effect does not happen.
does: Removes Draw, Dim, Boost, Muse's extra chain bonus, or Stop Time.
does_not: Does not remove the card, its printed Glow, or the basic +1 chain bonus.

contrast.dim: Dim takes Glow; Cancel takes an effect.
contrast.ward: Ward prevents Dim only; Cancel stops any one effect.
